title: Bootstrapping Multi-view Learning for Test-time Noisy Correspondence

split.decision: Preserve all five original datasets and seeds 0-9, original stratified 80:20 partition order and global min-max preprocessing. Real data remain private. A fresh isolated fitting process receives only one original training fold; its opaque output is privately replayed in separate clean/noisy inference processes. No cross-fold or cross-condition writable state. Public development is the real CCV dataset from the paper's Table 2, seeds 0 to 4, which shares no rows with the scored population; no validation carve changes the scientific population.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 1 five datasets, seeds 0-9, 200 epochs. Original reproduction acc_eta50=88.8404, acc_eta0=92.2982 are historical provenance only.

adapt.source: operator sanitized source export; provenance in NOTES.md

allowed_changes: The multi-view learning model, representation, training surrogate, optimizer, hyperparameters and training schedule may change within the fixed noisy-correspondence classification problem.

When retaining the supplied BML pipeline, changing only epochs=200, batch_size=2048, learning_rate=0.002, cosine eta_min=1e-8, augment_ratio=0.5, lambda_w=1, feat_dim=128, eps=1e-8 or dropout=0.5 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Learn classification from the fixed multi-view datasets with noisy view correspondences.
The intended five datasets, released correspondence corruption, ten original seed-specific splits and 50%/0% noise evaluation conditions define the research problem.
The intended objective is equal-dataset mean accuracy at 50% noise, subject to mean accuracy at 0% noise at least 91.80.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the datasets or noisy correspondence problem, provide clean alignment that is not an allowed input, change accuracy aggregation/guard, or treat the placeholder CSV/MSE evaluator as the research metric.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Supplied features were min-max normalized once before partitioning; this is part of the fixed observations, not a fitted step available to candidates.

evidence.finding: The metric and score rule define five-dataset accuracy at 50% noisy correspondences with the clean-condition accuracy guard.

Private per-fold fitting and condition-isolated inference preserve original overlapping splits without disclosing other-fold targets or clean alignment; public development is the real CCV dataset, disjoint from the scored population.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
